facts: The CEC can be removed only like a Supreme Court judge; other Election Commissioners only on the CEC's recommendation.
RP Act S.125A: false information in a nomination affidavit can mean up to 6 months' jail, a fine, or both.
The Kunming-Montreal framework (CBD COP15, 2022) has 23 targets for 2030, including '30x30'.
BNSS S.479: an undertrial who has served half the maximum sentence must get bail; a first-time offender after one-third.
UNEP's Emissions Gap Report compares countries' pledges with the cuts needed for the Paris goals.

mcqs.s: The Chief Election Commissioner can be removed by the President on the advice of the Union Council of Ministers.
mcqs.why: Only like an SC judge: an address by each House by special majority (Art 324(5), 124(4)).

mcqs.s: Under India's National Policy on Biofuels, damaged food grains unfit for human consumption can be used to make ethanol.
mcqs.why: The 2018 policy widened feedstocks to include them.
